scenes.basis: 3:1 "He entered again into the synagogue" - the Capernaum synagogue (1:21; 2:1), no town change narrated
3:7 "Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples" - the sea of the Galilee ministry (1:16; 3:8 multitudes "from Galilee")
3:13 "He went up into the mountain" - the mountain is unnamed
3:19 "Then he came into a house" - the house and town are not named
